checkpoint_approvals.comment: Approved as Functional Analyst; story points confirmed at 5. The team-map reframe (who produces — derived from role, no per-agent field, reconciled with US-023) and the execution-order prerequisite (US-023.BOLT-001 delivers the role→artifacts mapping before the roster Bolts) verified. Authorizes decomposition into 3 candidate functional Bolts.

Re-approved (material change, G15 — the Modelo B revision): TEMPLATE-ACTOR + roster.schema.yaml + INDEX.md + project_policy file + README; one file per actor (naming N-rule); project-chosen names; reusable definitions (N actors : 1 definition); per-instance authoritative model (model-level independence between actors sharing a definition); production derived from role (no produces field). Prior approval (16:06:31) kept as history. Authorizes the re-synced decomposition.

Re-approved (revision 3, material change G15 — the roster-as-enablement model, ADR-014 accepted 2026-08-24): roster.yaml as the team-membership authority + examples/ subfolder + TEMPLATE-ACTOR simplified (capabilities deferred to v2); the schema-valid roster entry is the enablement (no per-project ADR, no policy switch); v1 schema rule + roster.yaml consistency check; TEMPLATE-AITL-ENABLE-ADR.md + project-policy.yaml retired; BOLT-004 (the kit reshape + the four MainAgents naming the mechanism inline) added. Prior approvals (16:06:31, 17:37:47) kept as history. Authorizes creating BOLT-004.
